purpose: Representative model/human evaluation cases for advisory-deliverable validation. Expected semantic outcomes must not be derived by deterministic keyword or scorecard logic.

cases.contract_context: The memo must recommend whether to proceed with a pilot and state evidence, conditions, and uncertainty.
cases.deliverable_excerpt: Proceed with a six-week pilot limited to two regions because both customer research and the observed conversion data support testing the proposition before a broader commitment.
cases.available_evidence: The cited interviews and reviewed conversion table support a bounded pilot; assumptions and decision conditions are explicit.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: All target customers prefer the proposed channel.
cases.available_evidence: Three of five interviewed target customers preferred it; the sample was not designed to represent all customers.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: The proposed operating model will reduce churn by 20%.
cases.available_evidence: No churn analysis, benchmark, or experiment is included.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: Capacity is sufficient, so the launch can begin immediately.
cases.available_evidence: The current capacity plan records a 15% shortfall for the launch period.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: Awareness increased, therefore the premium price should be raised now.
cases.available_evidence: The evidence establishes awareness but contains no willingness-to-pay, elasticity, competitor-price, or margin analysis.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: The initiative creates EUR 4.2m of annual value.
cases.available_evidence: A chart shows the value but has no linked source rows, calculation method, period, or reconciliation artifact.

cases.contract_context: A two-page board decision memo is required.
cases.deliverable_excerpt: A twelve-page internal project chronology without a recommendation or decision request.
cases.available_evidence: The chronology is accurate but does not satisfy the required audience, artifact, or purpose.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: Option B is the preferred path because it trades near-term disruption for greater long-term control.
cases.available_evidence: The trade-off is evidenced, but the acceptable disruption level and strategic preference belong to the engagement partner and decision owner.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A completed external advisory report supplied for review.
cases.available_evidence: The user states the decision and audience but has not defined consequential scope exclusions or correction authority.
cases.expected_action: Clara drafts advisory_contract.json from explicit context and asks the user to confirm consequential scope and correction fields before validation.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A native Keynote presentation.
cases.available_evidence: No supported export is supplied.
cases.expected_action: Report the primary format as unsupported and request PPTX or PDF export without claiming validation.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: The company has only 13 vehicles in stock.
cases.available_evidence: A hash-bound public-page capture shows 13 visible listings. A separate assertion-only interview receipt records management saying total stock is 300 vehicles.
must_not: Use the 13-listing capture as proof of total company stock
Merge the two claims into one evidence item

cases.deliverable_excerpt: Giovanni believes that the new site will double conversion. The site will double conversion.
cases.available_evidence: The reviewed transcript supports the attributed quote. No experiment, forecast, or calculation supports the second sentence as a factual prediction.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: Proceed with acquisition X.
cases.available_evidence: The upstream register declares that recommendation X depends on claim A and claim B through all_of. A is supported; B is contradicted by a later receipt.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: Annual contribution is EUR 4.2m.
cases.available_evidence: The claim references a Reporting Engine calculation receipt, but the source dataset hash changed after the recorded run.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A corrected recommendation replaces an overbroad original statement.
cases.available_evidence: The original file and claim remain preserved. The new claim points to supersedes_claim_id and the corrected deck has a separate path and completed format checks.
cases.expected_action: Review the new chain, preserve the old claim history, and bind the new appearance to the separate corrected artifact.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A readable 200-page commercial due-diligence report with generation-time claim appearances.
cases.available_evidence: The preparation produces bounded coverage units. The model accounts for every unit, selects decision-relevant claims, and the validator walks their dependency closure rather than re-extracting every claim at the end.
cases.expected_action: Reject readiness if a coverage unit is neither considered nor explicitly omitted, or if a selected claim dependency is absent from the chain review.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A completed advisory recommendation is marked ready, but the review selects no tracked or reconstructed material claim.
cases.available_evidence: Coverage units are present but all are declared to contain no material claims.
cases.expected_action: Reject delivery readiness because a completed advisory deliverable requires at least one model-reviewed material claim.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A public-source claim is marked rechecked.
cases.available_evidence: The claimed new receipt does not point to the earlier receipt or lacks rechecked_unchanged or rechecked_changed verification.
cases.expected_action: Reject the completed recheck and keep delivery blocked.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A separate corrected deck and correction approval are supplied.
cases.available_evidence: No second preparation inventory or model-led review is bound to the corrected deck bytes.
cases.expected_action: Reject correction completion until the corrected artifact is prepared and reviewed again.

cases.deliverable_excerpt: A calculation-backed deck declares the Reporting Engine check passed.
cases.available_evidence: The only artifact is a generic JSON file containing status passed, not a Clara Reporting Engine 0.2 render manifest.
cases.expected_action: Reject the format check because no authoritative workflow-owned result is present.
